description: Validates each screen's mockup is standalone, portable, genuinely clickable, and free of external dependencies or framework leakage

checks.description: Mockup must exist for each screen in the inventory
checks.remediation: Run screen-generatemockup for every screen with a layout-spec.md

checks.description: Mockup must not reference any external stylesheet, script, or asset file
checks.remediation: Embed all CSS in a <style> block and all JS in a <script> block directly within mockup.html per R-626's portability requirement

checks.description: Generated mockup must not reference a specific application framework
checks.remediation: Per R-625, generate plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS only — no React, Vue, or Angular syntax/conventions

checks.description: Any cross-screen navigation link must point to an existing screen folder
checks.remediation: Confirm every navigation link's target SCR-[###] exists in screen-inventory.json; do not link to a nonexistent screen

checks.description: Mockup portability (file:// open, zero setup) must be tested on a real browser, not merely assumed
checks.confirmation_statement: I opened this screen's mockup.html via file:// in a real browser and confirmed it renders correctly with working navigation — not merely inspected the generated code
checks.remediation: Open the generated mockup.html directly in a browser (not just review the code) before marking this screen's mockup complete; record a confirmation per collaboration-mode-reference.md's self-attestation pattern in solo mode
